leadText:
Shizuka Itō (Japanese: 伊藤静 Itō Shizuka) is a Japanese voice actress for . She was born on December 5, 1980 in , .

In 2012, on her 32nd birthday, she announced that she had married. She is also a famous singer in her other career.
